generate_trajectory_3d_meta: generate a 3D Meta logo trajectory in free space using center pose, radius, and frequency parameters
compare_traj_tracking_error: compare a reference trajectory against reached states and print position and orientation error statistics
run_ee_tracking_joint_space: run end-effector tracking in joint space by computing inverse kinematics and moving to joint positions
run_ee_tracking_cartesian_space: run end-effector tracking in Cartesian space by moving directly to desired end-effector poses
run_ee_tracking_impedance_control: run end-effector tracking with online Cartesian impedance control by streaming pose updates at a fixed frequency
